claim_boundary.supports: Kernel-checked for every item type with decidable equality, in a Finset state machine with the six operations: the other five operations leave the admitted component unchanged in every state (supply_keeps_admitted is the corresponding frame lemma in this model; the Genesis supply_no_op in Inertia.lean was read but is external and not bound or imported here); one step changes the admitted set iff the operation is an Admit of an item not already admitted; for every finite trace the admitted set is the old set united with all admitted items of the trace and it changes iff the trace contains an Admit of a new item; for every token, Readings L (supply t) and F (supply t, admit t) end in different admitted states in the six-operation machine and in the same admitted state in the machine in which Supply also admits (a two-machine comparison, not an iff over a family of machines). By construction of the machine each operation writes its own state field and Retain and Operate are gated on admission, so that only Admit writes the admitted component and that the six operations are pairwise distinguishable are properties of this definition, not findings about a host. INSTANCES (Nat items): at the probe state with item 0 admitted the six operations on item 0 give six pairwise different results; on the trace [admit 0, admit 1, designate 0, designate 1] the Designate-also-retains machine retains both items while the six-operation machine retains none, and the second designation overwrites the first; admitting item 0 twice gives a set of size 1 (the source counter would give 2). Native exhaustive tables: all 22621 traces of length <= 4 over two items from each of four initial admitted sets (admitted state changes iff a new Admit occurs: 11510, 6516, 6516, 0 changing traces; the mismatch column is recomputed by the checker from flags carried through its programme); footprints of the six operations; 15 pair records (min_len = least length of a trace from the empty state after which some item gives different states under the two operations, over the two-item universe and lengths below 4; contexts = number of (trace of length <= 2, item) pairs at which they differ); 7 conflation counter-models with shortest witnesses (a conflation a_includes_b makes operation a first perform b on the same item); and Reading L / F records for the machines in which Supply also admits and in which Admit also supplies.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: That these six operations or state fields match any host, the Genesis Python model or the Genesis event semantics (forms, instances, requirements); that the six operations are distinct beyond writing distinct fields of this machine (Retain and Operate are gated on admission by definition); that conflating operations is the source of the Reading L / Reading F split of Genesis (a causal reading; only the model-level two-machine comparison is checked); more than two items or traces longer than 4 natively (the Lean statements are general, the Lean instances are Nat items); the inert-inscription model of PG-INERT-DIAMOND (cross-referenced, not imported); any physical or interpretive reading.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: By construction of its six state components, only Admit writes the admitted component of the six-operation state machine, and it changes it iff the item is new; the Reading L / Reading F pair has different admitted states in this machine and the same admitted state in the machine in which Supply also admits (a two-machine comparison for every token).
claim_boundary.next_test: Bridge this machine to the Genesis event model: define a simulation from the six operations to Derivation/Basic.lean stepE (supply a no-op, admitDatum an admission) and prove it preserves the admitted regime on the histories of the theorems historyL_replays and historyF_replays of Inertia.lean (external Genesis files, read but not bound and without a pinned sha256).

second_review.notes: Cold read. SixOperations.lean (identical to the p1/construction copy) recompiles, exit 0; all 13 anchors report propext+Classical.choice+Quot.sound (no weaker wording is used). Statement fidelity: supply_keeps_admitted (rfl), step_admitted_of_ne_admit, step_changes_admitted_iff, run_admitted (admitted after a trace = old set union the filterMap of Admit items), run_changes_admitted_iff, run_without_admit are genuine general theorems over any DecidableEq item type; readings_separated_six_ops and readings_collapse_when_supply_admits are general in the token; six_results_pairwise_distinct is a Fin 6 injectivity at one Nat probe (labelled INSTANCE); designate_retains_conflation_separates, designation_is_overwritten and repeated_admit_does_not_grow_set are Nat instances (labelled). The claim text matches: it opens 'for every item type' for the general theorems and has a separate 'INSTANCES (Nat items)' sentence. The model is circular by construction and the claim now says so ('By construction ... properties of this definition, not findings about a host'), including that Retain/Operate are gated by definition. Earlier-pass check: (a) amendments applied: pair min_len/contexts are now defined in supports; 'exactly when Supply does not admit' is replaced by the explicit two-machine comparison in supports and narrowest_claim; INSTANCE labelling done; causal clause added to does_not_support; 'distinct beyond writing distinct fields' added; mismatches is now computed in the checker (moved != has_new, carried through the DP) and not asserted; the three missing mutants plus the reverse conflation (admit_includes_supply, with a reading record in the certificate) were added; p4: 12 semantic and 494 coordinate mutants rejected, control accepted. NOT fully applied: (i) review.reviewed_target_qualification still says 'separated by the admitted state exactly when Supply does not admit', the wording the earlier pass struck from the claim (see amendment 3). (ii) The Genesis-provenance sentence: the amendment said 'was not read or imported here'; the sealed profile says 'Inertia.lean was read but is external and not bound or imported here' (and next_test says 'read but not bound'), whereas the sealed Lean docstring of supply_keeps_admitted says 'the external Genesis supply_no_op was not read or imported here'. These contradict each other inside the sealed bytes and nothing in the run's inputs contains Inertia.lean, so 'read' cannot be verified from the run. I checked the external repository (the_symbol_game, native_genesis_g12/original/lean4/Derivation): the identifiers do exist (Inertia.lean supply_no_op, historyL_replays; Basic.lean stepE, admitDatum). (c) New finding the earlier pass missed, bearing on next_test and on the 'source counter vs Finset' motivation: in Genesis Basic.lean the event admitDatum takes NO token and stepE does r.data + 1, i.e. Genesis itself models admission by a counter, and supply_no_op there is stepE r (.supply t) = some r (the whole regime is unchanged), whereas in this machine Supply writes the supplied field and only the admitted component is preserved. So the next_test 'simulation from the six operations to stepE (supply a no-op, admitDatum an admission)' cannot be a simulation of the Finset machine (repeated Admit of one item has size 1 here and +1 per event there) without first fixing an abstraction (forget the other fields and count distinct admitted tokens, or index Genesis admission by token). This is the real unpaid bridge and should be stated. Checker: real re-implementation (bitmasks, level DP over (state, flags), closed forms sum (6n)^k; I re-derived 22621, 11510, 6516, 6516, 0; conflation witnesses by DP over state pairs plus explicit lexicographic search; pairs by DP). Remaining weaknesses, none forcing a rebuild: the checker shares the author's step semantics (independent implementation, not independent specification); the G3 side conditions on footprints and on readings (conflated_separated == (name == admit_includes_supply)) are redundant with the exact comparison; the admit_includes_supply reading row has no Lean theorem (native only; the claim says native); only 2 of 7 conflation counter-models have Lean statements (supply_includes_admit, designate_includes_retain). Mutants are mostly one- or two-field record edits, each corresponding to a named misreading (supply writes admitted, retain ungated, operate writes admitted, repeated admit counted, designate=retain touching admitted, admit-includes-supply collapses readings). Nice-to-have missing near misses: Retain gated by 'supplied' instead of 'admitted' (footprint on a state where the item is supplied but not admitted); a pair record claiming Retain and Operate are distinguishable at length 0 (min_len 0 instead of 1). DAG: status DEFINITION stays; the DAG 'lean' list points at two vacuous source theorems and the bottleneck names supply_no_op; the result adds a model-level frame/iff and a two-machine Reading L/F comparison, not the causal clause.

earlier_pass.notes: Lean compiles (exit 0). Anchors are faithful as statements: supply_keeps_admitted (rfl), step_admitted_of_ne_admit, step_changes_admitted_iff, run_admitted, run_changes_admitted_iff, run_without_admit are correct general theorems over any DecidableEq I; readings_* are general in t. Axioms are propext+Classical.choice+Quot.sound for all 13 (no 'propext only' wording possible). Overstatements: (1) 'supply_keeps_admitted is the general form of the Genesis supply_no_op' - Inertia.lean is external and not bound or read; say 'the analogue in this model of'. (2) narrowest_claim and does_not_support say the Reading L/F pair is separated 'exactly when Supply does not admit'. Lean proves only a two-point comparison: separated in the six-operation machine, collapsed in the machine stepSupplyAdmits. 'Exactly when' needs a family of machines parameterised by what Supply does; as written it is not an iff theorem. (3) supports opens 'Kernel-checked for every item type with decidable equality' and then lists six_results_pairwise_distinct (instance: Fin 6, item 0, Nat probe), designate_retains_conflation_separates (instance: Nat items 0,1) and (via anchors) repeated_admit_does_not_grow_set (instance); these must be marked INSTANCE as the Lean docstrings do. (4) Circularity to state honestly: that only Admit writes the admitted component, and that the six operations are 'pairwise distinguishable', are true because the machine gives each operation its own state field (mention->mentioned, supply->supplied, ... operate->outputs); distinctness of six field-writers is by construction, and Retain/Operate are gated on admitted by definition. The kernel theorems verify that the machine meets its own specification of the DAG sentence; they are not evidence that a host or the Genesis model separates the operations. (5) The causal clause of the DAG node ('conflating them is the source of the Reading L/Reading F split') is untouched. Checker: a genuine re-implementation (bitmasks, level DP, closed forms; I re-derived 22621 = sum 12^k, 11510 = 22621-11111, 6516 = 22621-16105). Weaknesses: mismatches is hard-coded 0 in expected() and then required equal (implied by changed == closed form, but an asserted constant); pair records (min_len, contexts) are defined only by code (a context is a (state,item) at trace length <=2 with differing step results over a fixed 2-item universe, min over length<4) and nowhere in the claim boundary, so a wrong definition could not be detected; 'contexts' is an unexplained number. The checker shares the author's reading of the step semantics (independence of implementation, not of specification). Mutants: repeated_admit_counts_as_change, retain_equals_operate, mention_equals_supply, designate_retain_conflation_admits and supply_also_admits are genuine near-misses of stated bridges; readings_collapse_in_six_ops, full_admission_never_changes, retain_needs_no_admission and operate_writes_admitted are one-field edits, caught by exact recomputation. Missing: (a) reverse conflation 'admit includes supply' should NOT collapse the readings (a near miss claiming it does); (b) a conflation record with admitted_differs flipped on operate_includes_admit-type rows; (c) a pair record claiming designate and admit are indistinguishable. next_test: this node's own obligation (bridge to stepE/historyL/historyF), distinct from does_not_support; it names Derivation/Basic.lean stepE and Inertia.lean historyL/historyF which this node never read; the author should confirm the identifiers at the pinned sha or drop them. DAG: status DEFINITION appropriate; the statement mixes a definitional list with a causal clause the node does not touch.
